history.summary: Polished 5 woodland ley/shadow spells with distinct healing/ward/chill/damage scaling and removed sourcebook tags from descriptions.
Polished Jagged Forcelance, Lance of the Sun God, Outmaneuver, Hematomancy, and Converse with Dragon with thematic damage/healing/undead/evasion synergy and removed sourcebook tags.

Polished Protection from the Void (+Shield 2t), Shackle (+Chill 1t), Freezing Fog (+Chill 2t & Evade 1t), Beguiling Bet (+Evade 2t), and Starburst (+1 bonus & 2x vs Undead), removing all sourcebook tags.

Fixed Snow Fort from fire to frost (+Shield 2t & Chill 1t), polished Keening Wail (+2 bonus & Chill 2t), Sun's Bounty (+OOC healing), Ambusher's Regret (+1d8 force rebuke), and Jedza's Tidy Charm (+OOC 1d6 heal & Shield 1t), removing all sourcebook tags.

Polished Curse of Hostility (+Chill 2t), Ley Energy Bolt (2d8+2 force & Shield 1t), Blood Shards (3d6+3 necrotic & 1d8 siphon), Shadow Step (2d6 necrotic + Evade 2t & Chill 2t), and Lv.7 Timeless Engine (+OOC 3d8 heal, Shield 3t, Evade 2t), removing all sourcebook tags.

Polished Blizzard (3d8+4 frost, Chill 3t, Evade 1t), Een's Shredding Aura (2d8+2 slashing & Shield 2t), Gear Barrage (2d6+2 slashing & Chill 1t), Auspicious Warning (+Evade 2t), and Steady (+OOC 1d6 heal, Shield 2t, Chill 2t), removing all sourcebook tags.

Fixed Creeping Darkness from radiant/sun to necrotic/darkness (3d8+4, Chill 3t, Evade 2t), polished Investiture of Blight (+1d8 siphon & Shield 2t), Ley Disruption (+2d6 arcane backlash), Elemental Twist (+2 bonus & Evade 1t), and Detect Traps description, removing all sourcebook tags.

Polished 5 spells: added Evade to Shroud of Death, HP siphon to Soul Borrowing, necrotic/chill fix to Claws of Darkness, bumped Salt Lash to 2d8, and upgraded Targeting Foreknowledge to Bonus Action with Shield+Evade.
